sources.source_name: OS Open Linked Identifiers product structure
sources.evidence: Eleven relationship ZIP packages; CSV join tables plus Product Version Information JSON and licence/description files.
Free OpenData identifier API, JSON responses, five-working-day post-refresh update, and explicit no-geometry limitation.

sources.source_name: OS Linked Identifiers API identifier types endpoint

sources.source_name: OS Linked Identifiers API product version endpoint
sources.evidence: ProductVersionInfo endpoint returns current valid source-product version information for a correlation method.

sources.source_name: Title Number and UPRN Look Up technical specification
sources.evidence: Defines Title_No/UPRN linkage, missing/duplicate association risks, six-week AddressBase maintenance and monthly licensed delivery.
Separates National Polygon, Title Descriptor and Title Number/UPRN Look Up datasets; more than 25 million titles and 28 million polygons.
Every registered title has at least one index polygon; Poly_ID is spatial-object identity and Title_No manages title-to-polygon relationships.
